grandparents_cupboard.reason: Oats, eggs, milk, honey, chocolate, hazelnuts and yoghurt are all ordinary kitchen staples with nothing factory-made from a jar or packet.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a bowl, whisk, baking dish and oven, and the technique is simple mixing and baking.

works.reason: 200g oats to 400ml milk plus two eggs, baked at 190°C for 30 to 35 minutes, is a reliable baked oats ratio that sets well and serves four.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes covers zesting, peeling and slicing the clementines, chopping the chocolate and nuts, and whisking, and the 35-minute cook matches the bake time.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm baked breakfast suits mid-January, and the clementines are central, used as zest, as the baked topping and as fresh segments.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, plain British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Oats, eggs, milk, fruit, nuts and yoghurt make a filling breakfast, and 50g of chocolate shared between four is a modest treat rather than the bulk of the dish.
